title: ACAN, MDFI, and CHST1 as Candidate Genes in Gastric Cancer: A Comprehensive Insilco Analysis.
authors: Vafaeie, Farzane; Nomiri, Samira; Ranjbaran, Javad; Safarpour, Hossein
journal: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
one_liner_zh: 该文为胃癌基因表达芯片的共表达网络与差异表达分析，筛选候选生物标志物，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Gastric cancer (GC) is a complex disorder with an inadequate response to treatment. Although many efforts have been made to clarify the development of GC, the exact etiology and molecular mechanisms of this malignancy remain unclear. This study was designed to identify and characterize essential associated genes with GC to construct a prognostic model. METHODS: In this Insilco study, the gene expression microarray dataset GSE122401 was downloaded from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO). The raw data were processed and quantile-normalized with the edgeR package of R ver.3.5.3. The module-trait relationship and hub-genes associated with GC were analyzed with Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA). Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analyses were performed by Cluepedia and Enrichr Database. Finally, hub-genes were screened and validated by GEPIA online database. RESULTS: According to the WGCNA results, the blue module was found to be strongly correlated with the GC (r=0.91, p-value=1e-57). DEGs analysis was performed by edgeR package of R and indicated a total of 47 genes as hub-genes. Verifying the hub-genes expression using GEPIA online database showed a significantly increased level of ACAN gene expression in primary cancer cell line compared to metastatic cell line. On the other hand, the expression of MDFI and CHST1 genes in primary cell lines were lower compared to metastatic cancer cell lines. CONCLUSIONS: This study provides a framework of the co-expression gene modules ACAN, MDFI, and CHST1 as hub-genes. These hub-genes might offer candidate biomarkers to targeted therapy against GC. Further experiment validation and animal models are needed to reveal the exact mechanism of the above-mentioned genes in the pathogenesis and prognoses of GC.
abstract_zh: 背景：胃癌（GC）是一种复杂的疾病，对治疗反应不佳。尽管已做出许多努力来阐明GC的发展，但该恶性肿瘤的确切病因和分子机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在识别并表征与GC相关的重要基因，以构建预后模型。方法：在这项Insilco研究中，从基因表达综合数据库（GEO）下载了基因表达微阵列数据集GSE122401。使用R ver.3.5.3的edgeR包对原始数据进行处理并进行分位数归一化。通过加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）分析了与GC相关的模块-性状关系和枢纽基因。使用Cluepedia和Enrichr数据库进行基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）富集分析。最后，通过GEPIA在线数据库筛选并验证枢纽基因。结果：根据WGCNA结果，蓝色模块被发现与GC强相关（r=0.91，p值=1e-57）。通过R的edgeR包进行DEGs分析，共鉴定出47个基因作为枢纽基因。使用GEPIA在线数据库验证枢纽基因表达显示，与原代癌细胞系相比，转移性细胞系中ACAN基因表达水平显著升高。另一方面，原代细胞系中MDFI和CHST1基因的表达低于转移性癌细胞系。结论：本研究提供了共表达基因模块ACAN、MDFI和CHST1作为枢纽基因的框架。这些枢纽基因可能为针对GC的靶向治疗提供候选生物标志物。需要进一步的实验验证和动物模型来揭示上述基因在GC发病机制和预后中的确切机制。
